overview_description.description: Nest Labs is a home automation producer of programmable, self-learning, sensor-driven, Wi-Fi-enabled thermostats, smoke detectors, and other security systems. It introduced the Nest Learning Thermostat in 2011 as its first product. The Nest Protect smoke and carbon monoxide detector was then introduced in October 2013. After acquiring Dropcam, the rebranded Nest Cam was introduced in June 2015.

product.name: Nest Learning Thermostat
product.description: A Wi-Fi-enabled thermostat that learns user preferences to control home heating and cooling automatically.

product.name: Nest Protect
product.description: A smoke and carbon monoxide detector with sensors that monitor home safety and provide alerts.

product.name: Nest Cam
product.description: A Wi-Fi-enabled security camera that streams live video and records footage for home monitoring.

product.name: Nest Hello
product.description: A video doorbell that streams live video and allows two-way communication at the home entrance.

product.name: Nest Secure
product.description: A home security system that integrates sensors and alarms to monitor and protect residential properties.

product.description: A professional installation service connecting customers with trained installers for Nest products.
